turns: Yaya yanayin kiwon lafiya a Jihar Sokoto?
reply:
🧭 Tambaya mai fadi: ina tsara binciken…
---
📚 Ina karanta takardu 7: plans, partner reports, budgets, policies… (har zuwa minti 3)
---
✍️ Ina rubuta taƙaitawa daga alƙaluma 22 da aka tabbatar…
---
A 2026 rahoton ya nuna akwai cibiyoyin lafiya masu aiki 586 a fadin jiha mai yawan jama'a da aka yi hasashen 6,967,608 a 2026 (Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (EmONC) Assessment and…, p. 37), yayin da tsarin Minimum Service Package tun as of the 2020 report ya bukaci manyan PHCs 244 masu aiki (Sokoto State Minimum Service Package for Primary Health Care…, p. 7), kuma a lokacin aka gano gibin cibiyoyi 207 da ke bukatar gyara da 26 da ba sa nan kwata-kwata da ake bukatar ginawa.
Game da ma'aikata, akwai ma'aikatan sahun gaba 3,395 a tsarin PHC as of the 2020 report (Sokoto State Minimum Service Package for Primary Health Care…, p. 6), sai dai as of the 2023 report ana bukatar ma'aikatan jinya 5,429 bisa rabon 1 ga mutane 1,000 da ungozoma 1,650 don haihuwa (State Health Resource Optimization Plan (ROP) to Improve Healthcare…, p. 30), kuma cikin PHCs 84 da aka tantance, 26 ne kawai suka cika mafi karancin bukatar ma'aikata (State Health Resource Optimization Plan (ROP) to Improve Healthcare…, p. 9) idan aka kwatanta da ma'aunin WHO na ma'aikatan lafiya 2.5 ga mutane 1,000.
Kasafin lafiya na jiha ya tashi daga Naira biliyan 15.81 a 2018 zuwa Naira biliyan 29.6 a 2022 (State Health Resource Optimization Plan (ROP) to Improve Healthcare…, p. 6), inda kaso na 15.7% na kasafin gwamnati a 2022 ya wuce burin Abuja Declaration na 15%, yayin da kashe kudin aljihu na iyali ya kai 73.5% na kashewar lafiya a 2018.
Dangane da hidima, a 2024 mata masu samun kulawar ciki daga kwararru sun kai 26.4%, haihuwar gida 87.5%, amfani da maganin hana daukar ciki 6.9% ciki har da na zamani 6.0%, yayin da as of the 2020 report cibiyoyin PHC 547 ke gudanar da akalla zaman rigakafi 4 a wata.
Takardun tsare-tsare sun sanya buri na kayatarwa da samar da ma'aikata ga cibiyoyi 92 a 2025 karkashin Safe Deliveries Initiative a kananan hukumomi 23 da kuma fannonin fifiko 13 a karkashin SWAp as of the 2025 report (Sokoto State 2025 Health Sector-wide Annual Operational Plan, p. 23).
---

---
*Health facilities and infrastructure*
As of the 2026 report akwai cibiyoyin lafiya masu aiki 586 a fadin yankuna hudu (Emergency Obstetric and Newborn Care (EmONC) Assessment and…, p. 37) don biyan bukatar al'umma da aka yi hasashen za su kai mutane 6,967,608 a 2026.
As of the 2020 report, an kiyasta cewa ana bukatar manyan PHCs 244 masu aiki don cika ka'idojin Minimum Service Package (Sokoto State Minimum Service Package for Primary Health Care…, p. 7), amma a lokacin akwai gibi na cibiyoyi 207 da ke bukatar gyara da wasu 26 da ba sa wanzuwa kwata-kwata da ake bukatar ginawa.
---
*Health workforce and staffing*
Adadin ma'aikatan sahun gaba a tsarin PHC ya kai mutane 3,395 as of the 2020 report (Sokoto State Minimum Service Package for Primary Health Care…, p. 6).
As of the 2023 report, an kiyasta bukatar ma'aikatan jinya 5,429 bisa rabon 1 ga mutane 1,000 (State Health Resource Optimization Plan (ROP) to Improve Healthcare…, p. 30) da ungozoma 1,650 don kula da haihuwa na shekara, yayin da cikin PHCs 84 da aka tantance, 26 ne kawai suka cika mafi karancin bukatar ma'aikata (State Health Resource Optimization Plan (ROP) to Improve Healthcare…, p. 9).
Wannan yana nuni ga gibin da aka auna da ma'aunin WHO na ma'aikatan lafiya 2.5 ga mutane 1,000 don tabbatar da 95% na haihuwa da kwararru.
---
*Health financing, funding and spending*
Kasafin lafiya na jiha ya karu daga Naira biliyan 15.81 a 2018 (State Health Resource Optimization Plan (ROP) to Improve Healthcare…, p. 6) zuwa Naira biliyan 29.6 a 2022.

turns: What is the state of primary healthcare in Sokoto State?
reply:
🧭 A broad question: I'm planning the analysis…
---
📚 Reading 11 documents: budgets and budget reports, plans, partner reports, financial statements, surveys and statistics… (up to 3 minutes)
---
✍️ Writing the summary from 23 checked figures…
---
As of the 2025 report there were 751 public Primary Health Care Centres in Sokoto State (Sokoto State Health Sector Medium-Term Sector Strategy (MTSS) 2025 –…, p. 18), but as of the 2020 report 207 facilities required upgrade to meet the Minimum Service Package standard (Sokoto State Minimum Service Package for Primary Health Care…, p. 7) and over 70% were without the equipment required for delivery of services (Sokoto State Minimum Service Package for Primary Health Care…, p. 6).
As of the 2023 report, 26 of 84 PHCs assessed met the minimum human resources requirements (State Health Resource Optimization Plan (ROP) to Improve Healthcare…, p. 9) and 160 PHCs received BHCPF funding after business plan review (State Health Resource Optimization Plan (ROP) to Improve Healthcare…, p. 18).
For staffing as of the 2020 report, 78 nurses and midwives were available against 244 required with 3,395 frontline staff available in total out of 11,202 total personnel, while 46 medical officers were required.
Funding shows the Primary Health Care Development Agency approved budget was ₦7.12 billion in 2026 (Sokoto State FY 2026 Budget, p. 18) representing 5.9% of the health allocation (Sokoto State FY 2026 Budget, p. 32), with its share of spending falling from 78.1% in 2023 (Sokoto State Government 2025 Approved Budget, p. 12) to 40.0% in 2024 (Budget Performance Report Q4 2024, p. 20) and 11.3% in 2025 (Budget Implementation Report Q4 2025, p. 19).
